name: Jonas
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: So when they had dined, Jesus saith to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me more than these? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my lambs. If you love me, feed my lambs.
He saith to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? He saith unto him, Yea, Lord; thou knowest that I love thee. He saith unto him, Feed my sheep.

He saith unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, lovest thou me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Lovest thou me? And he said unto him, Lord, thou knowest all things; thou knowest that I love thee. Jesus saith unto him, Feed my sheep. Do not forget, you were chosen to feed my sheep. You made this agreement, this covenant with me in the heavens before you came to the earth. Do not forget to feed my sheep. His commander gave him his orders and made sure he did not forget them. He repeated them three times before he left him.
